response:
I'm so sorry you're going through this pain. What you're feeling—the unsettlement, the intrusive thoughts, the hurt—is completely normal, even when you've chosen to forgive. Healing from infidelity takes time, and wanting to move forward doesn't mean the emotions switch off right away. The fact that she forgave you in the past shows there's a foundation of commitment between you, but that doesn't make this any less difficult.

Consider seeking couples counseling with a licensed therapist who can help you both process this together in a safe, structured space. Individual therapy could also help you work through the intrusive thoughts and find healthy ways to cope. Rebuilding trust is possible, but it rarely happens alone—you deserve support as you navigate this. Be patient with yourself; healing isn't linear, and it's okay to still feel hurt even while choosing to stay.
